items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution. The authoritative candidate list is empty; 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 28 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 2 outcomes are proven. Continue existing measurement and attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence. Preserve CRO opportunities from SEO, affiliate, UX, repository, and audience signals as deferred backlog; do not create new production work, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, spend, requeues, or monetization expansion until ownership, validation, rollback, deduplication, measurement, security, and financial gates clear. Keep the gated product private and external outreach unsent pending counsel and owner authorization. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only and does not support site-level ROI or revenue claims.
